# Reiver

> Production AI control plane - OpenTelemetry-native observability, LLM gateway, and prompt hub in one.

Reiver sits in the LLM request path. It is not a side-car observer — it routes, controls, and records every LLM call in production.

## Components

- **Flow**: LLM gateway — routes requests across providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock), enforces rate limits, manages failover, tracks cost per token.
- **Watch**: APM and tracing — OpenTelemetry-native, receives traces and spans, built-in data warehouse (no separate storage bill).
- **Hub**: Prompt management — version, test, and roll out prompt changes safely across environments.
- **Herd**: Agent registry — catalog and manage AI agents in production.
- **Moodeng**: Agent-assisted operations — user-triggered investigation and operations through MCP. Not autonomous; the user's coding agent drives every action.
